about_the_game:
■About Sp(L/R)ite

SP(L/R)ITE is an adventure game where you must escape a series of mysterious floating rooms in another dimension.

Uncover the secrets hidden within each room as you collaborate with an unnervingly energetic goddess and a neighbor you can only speak to through the wall.

What lies beyond the final door? That’s for you to decide.

■Beyond the Truth Lies a Choice...

You wake with a strange feeling—something isn't right.

The ceiling, the room… they seem familiar. But your sense of smell is gone.

Confused, you're soon greeted by Akrida, a self-proclaimed goddess of fate.

She tells you that you've been chosen to participate in a battle to the death.

Your opponent? A stranger—someone you can only hear through the wall.

It's a race to escape this mysterious dimension…or so you’re told.

Jean, the voice on the other side, is suspicious of Akrida and urges you to work with her to find a way out together.

Surprisingly, Akrida doesn’t resist. In fact, she encourages cooperation, claiming you can escape by any means necessary.

As you continue to interact with Jean—and receive occasional guidance from Akrida—you slowly begin to uncover the truth you once forgot.

■Unravel the Story, One Puzzle at a Time...

Sp(L/R)ite unfolds within a locked, crumbling house—an isolated, otherworldly space born from an unforeseen tangling of the “threads of fate” spun by Akrida.

To move from one room to the next, you’ll need to gather scattered items and piece together a mysterious picture—the key to your escape—guided by clues from Jean and Akrida.

With each image you complete, Jean’s and your lost memories begin to surface, slowly revealing your intertwined pasts and drawing you closer to the story’s end.

What future lies ahead for you two? That depends on the choices you make.

Sp(L/R)ite is a short adventure game project created by Tricore, an indie developer based in Fukuoka, Japan.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel i7- 14700F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: You awaken in a strange, floating room in another dimension. To escape, you'll need to team up with an energetic goddess and a mysterious girl just beyond the wall. Together, you’ll unravel the secrets of this surreal space in this adventure game. Which door will you choose—and where will it lead?

English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
